create_glfw_context: create a GLFWContext OpenGL renderer with a specified maximum framebuffer width and height
init_glfw_context: initialize a GLFWContext with an invisible single-buffered window for offscreen rendering
make_context_current: make the GLFW OpenGL context current for rendering operations on the main thread
free_glfw_context: free GLFW window resources and destroy the OpenGL context when rendering is complete
review_glfwcontext_class: review the GLFWContext class that provides a GLFW-backed OpenGL context for dm_control rendering
